yt_title: Stop asking AI for answers. Make it your tutor
caption:
Stop asking AI for the answers.

A saved reel said AI makes you a better learner. Only if you set it up like a tutor:
1. "Don't give me answers. Ask me one question at a time."
2. "Push back when I'm wrong."
3. "Quiz me at the end and tell me my weakest area."

Works on the free Claude plan.

Sorted by SaveSort. Sort your saves free, link in bio.
